description: Versioned required native acceptance checks per chunk. xtask requires a native-acceptance record to report exactly this ID set, each with result pass, a nonempty observation and at least one evidence file listed in the review packet. Changing a list is a reviewed source change.

C01.check: Fixture app launches from the prepared bundle; window title 'Prisma AIRS Desktop v2 (Fixture)'; rail shows 'Fixture build'.
Native menus: app menu (About, Settings… Cmd+,, Hide, Quit), Edit, View (Command Palette… Cmd+K, Appearance, zoom), Go (destinations Cmd+1–Cmd+9), Window.

Keyboard only: Tab reaches the Features navigation; Enter on a destination moves focus to its heading and marks it current; a visible focus ring is rendered on focused controls (fixture WebView self-capture).
Cmd+K opens the palette with focus in the field; typing filters; Enter navigates and closes; Escape closes and restores focus to the previously focused control.
Go-menu shortcuts (Cmd+2 Academy, Cmd+, Settings) navigate through the native menu and observation channel, including while the palette is open (palette closes, heading receives focus).
Every product destination states it is not available in this build with its planned chunk; none shows data or contacts a service.
Settings > Appearance and View > Appearance change the general theme (Paper light / Gruvbox dark / match system) only after the native snapshot arrives.

Accessibility tree: 'Features' navigation landmark; destination buttons expose names (including 'Not available in this build'); the current destination is exposed; page headings are in reading order. Records which AX attributes were inspected; spoken VoiceOver output is not claimed unless separately recorded.
Resizing to the minimum window size (900x600) keeps rail, topbar and content usable without overlap or clipping of controls.
Zoom/large text: View zoom in to 150% and 200% (Cmd+=) keeps navigation, headings and settings readable and operable; Cmd+0 restores.

Reduced motion: with macOS Reduce Motion enabled, every automated C01 flow still passes (no control depends on motion), and the stylesheet built into the same native-prepare run contains the shared prefers-reduced-motion clamp.
No Academy learner or gamification element (XP, credits, streak, notifications, earned skins) appears on general screens.
Startup makes no internet connection (referencing evidence/C01/native/startup-network.json for the same executable).

C02.check: Settings > Tenants: the labelled Add tenant form (Label, TSG ID, destination radios, Region pop-up) is operated by keyboard and creates a tenant that appears in the tenant list and becomes the active tenant.

Keychain scan key: the AIRS API key field is a secure text field whose AX value never exposes the key; saving stores one item under the fixture namespace in the dedicated fixture test keychain (item attributes inspected, secret never read) and reports 'Scan key saved in the Keychain.'; the key appears in no AX snapshot.
Persistence across relaunch: after quitting and relaunching, the tenant, its active selection, its Keychain scan-key status and the Dark appearance are restored (C01 carry-over).
Session-only scan key: 'Scan key held for this session only.' with no Keychain item added; after relaunch that tenant reports a missing scan key.

Reviewed endpoint override: Change destination with a custom HTTPS origin shows a review naming both origins and the key removal; confirming changes the destination, removes the scan key (its Keychain item is deleted) and requires a new key.

Profile import through the native open sheet attached to the main window: a synthetic airs-cli registry with an embedded synthetic secret and a credential-file reference previews names, TSG IDs and discarded-field counts, the secret appears nowhere in the AX tree, and importing creates keyless tenants.

Locked credential store: with the fixture keychain locked through the app's own keychain reference (fixture-only menu), saving a scan key reports that the Keychain is locked, shows no OS prompt and falls back to nothing; after unlocking, saving succeeds and the retired record is cleaned up.
Reset local data (two-step confirmation) removes the v2 tenants, preference document and every fixture-namespace Keychain item; v1 Application Support data is unchanged.
Corrupt local data: an unreadable state document is reported ('Local desktop data could not be read'), left byte-identical, creating a tenant is refused, and Reset recovers.

Keyboard and VoiceOver attributes of the tenant UI: Tab reaches the tenant form fields, storage-mode radios and actions in order; per-tenant actions are named ('Make … active', 'Delete …'); a refusal is exposed as an alert.
No internet sockets during startup with tenants and stored scan keys present (C02 makes no scan or validation request).
At 200% zoom and at the minimum window size the scan-key field and its Save action are reachable by Tab and lie inside the window, clear of the bottom fade.
